sloka: यः स्थितम् योजने शैलम् गच्चन् पार्श्वेन सेवते ।ऊर्ध्वम् तथैव कायेन गतः प्राप्नोति योजनम् ॥६-२७-१७॥।।
transliteration: yaḥ sthitam yojane śailam gaccan pārśvena sevate ।ūrdhvam tathaiva kāyena gataḥ prāpnoti yojanam ॥6-27-17॥।।

translations.english: "He who stands at one yojana touches a mountain with his flanks, so also gets up and reaches a yojana height with his body, is Sannadana. He is the grandfather of Vanaras. There is no one who has a bigger body size than him among the four legged ones. He had fought war with Indra and is well known for not losing in the battle."
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! यह वानरराज इन्द्र के पास रहने बाला है । देखिये बड़ी भारी सेना को साथ शिये .हुए यह दर्भ नामक यूथप है
